title: Scene 4 - Policy written in prose
description: The same kind of policy, written the way it actually arrives: a sentence from a compliance owner, not JSON. Switch the policy input to 'Plain English' and run it - the interpreter agent expands it to region IDs, and every region it returns is checked against the official catalog before the gate runs. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY; the structured JSON below is the same policy for running without a key.
policy_text: All production workloads holding customer data must stay inside Japan. Nothing may run outside Japanese regions, however much cleaner the grid is elsewhere.

policy.name: Japan residency (structured equivalent)
policy.description: Synthetic demo policy. Shown here as JSON so the scene also runs without a model.
